SELECT 'IMC006',f.imc_season,f.sm_fixture_id,CONCAT('IMC006|S',LPAD(f.imc_season,2,'0'),'|NATIONS|worldcup'),'worldcup',NEW.sm_country,NEW.sm_division,'NATIONS',f.group_name,f.competition_stage,f.competition_round,f.match_date,f.home_id,COALESCE(f.home_name,NEW.home_name),f.away_id,COALESCE(f.away_name,NEW.away_name),NEW.home_sm_manager_id,NEW.away_sm_manager_id,NEW.home_score,NEW.away_score,'COMPLETED',COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.fingerprint,''),SHA2(CONCAT(f.world_id,'|worldcup|',f.sm_fixture_id),256)),NEW.imported_at r.match_date=f.match_date AND r.home_sm_club_id=f.home_id AND r.away_sm_club_id=f.away_id AND r.sm_action='worldcup'))); END IF; END
